Finish Firebase setup

The Closet web app is connected to the closet-404e9 Firebase project. Use this checklist to confirm the console-side services and access rules.

  1. Web app connectedThe supplied Firebase web configuration is installed in this artifact.
  2. Enable Google sign-inAuthentication → Sign-in method → Google → Enable. Add the published artifact domain to Authorized domains.
  3. Create FirestoreCreate the default Cloud Firestore database in production mode.
  4. Enable Cloud StorageCreate the default Storage bucket. Uploaded photos will live under users/{uid}/items.
  5. Publish access rulesPublish the per-user Firestore and Storage rules below in their respective Rules tabs.
Firestore rules

Each signed-in person can access only their own item documents.

rules_version = '2';
service cloud.firestore {
  match /databases/{database}/documents {
    match /users/{userId}/items/{itemId} {
      allow read, create, update, delete:
        if request.auth != null && request.auth.uid == userId;
    }
  }
}
Storage rules

Only image uploads under 10 MB are accepted, and only for the signed-in owner.

rules_version = '2';
service firebase.storage {
  match /b/{bucket}/o {
    match /users/{userId}/items/{allPaths=**} {
      allow read: if request.auth != null && request.auth.uid == userId;
      allow write: if request.auth != null
        && request.auth.uid == userId
        && request.resource.size < 10 * 1024 * 1024
        && request.resource.contentType.matches('image/.*');
    }
  }
}
